subject.title: perf(agents): slim Skill Workshop prompt section to its routing contract

question: Should this PR's concise Skill Workshop prompt wording be accepted as the maintained routing contract for durable skill work?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but this is a model-facing safety and tone choice on a protected `maintainer`-labeled PR, so automation should not substitute for maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve concise split
options.body: Accept the PR's two-line prompt section plus schema-based mechanics because the service and approval hooks still own persistence and lifecycle enforcement.

options.title: Strengthen wording before merge
options.body: Ask for one additional concise phrase if maintainers want lifecycle changes explicitly named in the system prompt rather than only in the schema.

options.title: Keep verbose guardrails
options.body: Reject or pause this direction if maintainers prefer redundant prompt-level prohibitions over the token and tone improvement.

recommendation.title: Approve concise split
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's two-line prompt section plus schema-based mechanics because the service and approval hooks still own persistence and lifecycle enforcement.
